highlights.degree: B.S. / M.S. / Ph.D. in Computer Science

overview: The United States represents a preeminent destination for scholars studying computer science distinguished by its sophisticated technological infrastructure, abundant research prospects, and industry-aligned pedagogical frameworks.

faq.question: Can Indian students who have completed their Class 12 education pursue undergraduate studies in computer science in the United States?
faq.answer: Yes, after completing Class 12 or an equivalent degree, Indian students can apply to undergraduate computer science degree programs.

faq.question: How long does it usually take to earn a degree in computer science in the US?
faq.answer: A master's degree usually involves one to two years of coursework and research, while an undergraduate bachelor's degree normally requires four years.
